Subject: leak at Fort Nelson station
Hey,
Got a call from the field crew at the Fort Nelson station around noon today. They were doing
a routine pig receive when they noticed a leak at one of the flange gaskets. Metering shows
about 13.4 m³ released, but everything stayed inside the station fence. Crew isolated the
section and got it under control.
Not sure if it was wear or just a bad gasket-haven't heard the final word yet. Will follow up if
anything else comes in.
Mark, Control Room
